steps.en: Write the diagram as text in a fenced mermaid block
steps.zh: 在 Markdown 里写一个 mermaid 围栏块，用文本画图

steps.en: Host platforms like GitHub, GitLab and docs sites render the block inline as SVG
steps.zh: GitHub、GitLab 等宿主平台直接把这块文本渲染成 SVG

steps.en: Rendering it yourself (site or CI)? Add the library or the headless CLI
steps.zh: 要自己渲染（网站或 CI），加上库或无头 CLI

steps.en: Parses the syntax, auto-lays-out with the bundled ELK engine (dagre selectable) and emits SVG/PNG
steps.zh: 解析语法，用内嵌 ELK 引擎自动排版（可切 dagre），输出 SVG/PNG

value.en: Diagrams that live as diffable text in the repo — edit a line in a PR and the picture follows
value.zh: 图表以可 diff 的文本活在仓库里——PR 里改一行，图就跟着变
